note: Week 2026-08-17 build. Prior 8/10-8/14 book closed at official Fri 8/14 SIP closes for +5207.62 realized (winners NBIS +2621, SMCI +1385, CRWV +1279, LITE +786, DKNG +392, NVDA +220; losers JD -574, CSCO -503, AMAT -192, UBER -144, PLTR -45, ABNB -19). New week is a barbell: (1) the AI hardware supply chain, where the fresh catalyst is Samsung's memory supply warning plus JPMorgan's SNDK upgrade to Overweight ($2,250 PT) and Fabrinet's Mon 8/17 AMC print anchoring optical; (2) a dense retail earnings slate testing the consumer — TJX/LOW/TGT Wed, WMT/BABA/DE Thu BMO, ROST Thu AMC — into which the XRT retail ETF fell 2% last week, resetting the bar. RDDT is a mechanical add: it joins the S&P 500 before Tuesday's open, replacing AvalonBay. Macro in-window: July FOMC minutes Wed 8/19 from a contentious meeting with three hike dissents under Chair Warsh; Jackson Hole is 8/27-29, outside the window. 15 names, ~86.9% deployed, ~13.1% cash. Entries recorded at verified Fri 8/14 SIP closes; positions open Monday 8/17.

positions.name: Fabrinet
positions.catalyst: Q4 FY26 results Mon 8/17 AMC — guidance $1.25-1.29B rev / $3.72-3.87 EPS; two 800G datacom transceiver programs ramping directly to a hyperscaler, 1.6T next. First earnings print of the week and the cleanest in-window AI-optical catalyst.
positions.risks: Binary earnings on night one of the hold; customer concentration (NVDA/Cisco); optical names already up sharply into the print.
positions.driver: Marquee in-window earnings catalyst for the AI optical supply chain.

positions.name: Micron Technology
positions.catalyst: Memory supercycle: Samsung warned of tightening supply, driving a sector-wide re-rate (MU +6% Thu, +15% on the 7/30 move). Q3 FY26 rev $41.46B beat consensus by 17.6%; HBM/enterprise SSD content per AI rack still climbing.
positions.risks: No company-specific catalyst in-window; +237% YTD leaves it extended; hawkish FOMC minutes could hit high-beta semis.
positions.driver: Confirmed sector momentum on a fresh supply-tightening catalyst.

positions.name: Sandisk
positions.catalyst: JPMorgan upgrade to Overweight with a $2,250 target (~37% upside from Friday's close) plus the 2026 Investor Day long-term model; NAND pricing power from Samsung's supply warning. +15-22% moves on 8/12-8/14.
positions.risks: Most extended name in the book (+544% YTD); no earnings in-window; violent two-way volatility.
positions.driver: Strongest momentum in the memory complex confirmed by a fresh sell-side upgrade.

positions.name: NVIDIA
positions.catalyst: Q2 FY27 results confirmed for Wed 8/26 — the week's setup is the classic pre-print drift into the AI bellwether, with consensus looking for >50% YoY data-center-led growth. Trades ~5% below its 52-wk high of $236.54.
positions.risks: Catalyst is outside the hold window, so this is drift not event; mega-cap profit-taking hit tech Friday afternoon.
positions.driver: AI anchor position with a well-telegraphed catalyst just beyond the window.

positions.name: TJX Companies
positions.catalyst: Q2 earnings Wed 8/19 BMO, consensus $1.19 EPS. Off-price is the share-gainer when trade-down accelerates, and the XRT retail ETF fell 2% last week — a low bar into the print.
positions.risks: Binary earnings; July retail sales fell 0.6% MoM; apparel inventory/tariff commentary could disappoint.
positions.driver: In-window earnings catalyst in the trade-down winner, with sentiment already reset.

positions.name: Analog Devices
positions.catalyst: Q3 earnings Wed 8/19 BMO, consensus $3.34 EPS. Analog/industrial cycle recovery plus growing data-center power content; stock sits ~13% below its June 52-wk high of $445.91 so the setup isn't stretched.
positions.risks: Binary earnings; industrial/auto end markets still choppy; 58x trailing P/E leaves little room for a soft guide.
positions.driver: In-window earnings catalyst with a non-extended chart.

positions.name: Western Digital
positions.catalyst: HDD/NAND tightness — WDC jumped ~18% on the 7/30 supply move and ~10% again Friday as hyperscaler nearline demand outruns supply. Nebius' $37.5B RPO disclosure underlines multi-year storage attach to GPU buildouts.
positions.risks: No in-window print; ~36% below its June high signals prior volatility; commodity pricing can reverse fast.
positions.driver: Third leg of the storage-stack momentum trade on a confirmed supply catalyst.

positions.name: Walmart
positions.catalyst: Q2 FY27 results Thu 8/20 BMO — consensus $0.74 EPS (+8.8% YoY) on $186.9B rev (+6.3%). Jefferies flags underappreciated earnings power from tariff refunds reinvested into price, plus e-commerce and ad-revenue margin mix.
positions.risks: Binary earnings; stock is ~15% off its May high on consumer-spend worries; an in-line quarter may not be enough.
positions.driver: Defensive in-window catalyst and the cleanest read on the low-income consumer.

positions.name: Lumentum Holdings
positions.catalyst: Direct read-through from Fabrinet's Mon 8/17 AMC print; 800G/1.6T transceiver and EML laser demand is component-constrained rather than demand-constrained per the latest optical commentary. Rose 13.8% last week.
positions.risks: Held from last week and extended; a soft FN guide would hit it immediately; still unprofitable on a trailing basis.
positions.driver: Momentum continuation with a dated, external catalyst on night one.

positions.name: Reddit
positions.catalyst: Joins the S&P 500 effective before the open Tue 8/18, replacing AvalonBay (acquired by Equity Residential). Off-cycle add means index funds must complete buying into Monday's close/Tuesday's open — mechanical demand inside the window.
positions.risks: Announced Friday 8/14 and shares already popped, so partly priced; index adds frequently fade after the effective date.
positions.driver: Mechanical index-inclusion flow dated squarely inside the hold window.

positions.name: CoreWeave
positions.catalyst: Post-earnings momentum continuation off the 8/11 print (+19.3% last week) with the AI-cloud backlog narrative intact and neocloud capacity contracts driving the whole memory/optical complex.
positions.risks: No fresh catalyst in-window; unprofitable and high beta; ~31% below its 52-wk high with a wide trading range.
positions.driver: Momentum continuation in the neocloud theme powering the rest of the book.

positions.name: Alibaba Group
positions.catalyst: Q1 FY27 earnings Thu 8/20 BMO, consensus ~$10.03 EPS. Cloud/AI revenue reacceleration is the swing factor; at 19x trailing and 36% below its October high, expectations are low.
positions.risks: Binary earnings; JD's -13% week showed China e-commerce headline risk is live; ADR/regulatory overhang.
positions.driver: Cheap in-window earnings catalyst with an AI-cloud kicker.

positions.name: Keysight Technologies
positions.catalyst: Q3 earnings Tue 8/18 AMC, consensus $2.48 EPS. Test-and-measurement demand is a direct derivative of 800G/1.6T optical and AI-datacenter validation spend — the same driver powering FN and LITE.
positions.risks: Binary earnings; 59x trailing P/E; aerospace/defense and auto segments can offset datacenter strength.
positions.driver: In-window earnings catalyst levered to the same AI-networking cycle.

positions.name: Ross Stores
positions.catalyst: Q2 earnings Thu 8/20 AMC, consensus $1.94 EPS. Off-price peer to TJX; the stock set a 52-wk high on 8/3 before the sector pullback, so the trend is intact into the print.
positions.risks: Binary earnings late in the window leaves little time to react; weaker July retail sales; more US-concentrated than TJX.
positions.driver: Second off-price earnings catalyst confirming the trade-down theme.

positions.name: Deere & Company
positions.catalyst: Q3 earnings Thu 8/20 BMO, consensus $4.69 EPS. Ag equipment is trough-cycle with easy comps; management's FY guide and early read on 2027 order books are the swing factors.
positions.risks: Binary earnings; farm income and used-equipment inventories still soft; construction/forestry exposed to a hawkish Fed.
positions.driver: Non-tech in-window earnings catalyst diversifying an AI-heavy book.
